_base_model_rationale: Small (~135M params) multilingual encoder, covers German. Chosen over a generative LLM (Qwen/Llama) because this is a 10-way classification task and there is no GPU on this machine - a LoRA-adapted classification head on a small encoder is realistically trainable on CPU/MPS in minutes, whereas fine-tuning a multi-billion-parameter generative model locally would not be.
